attributes.name: Cloak of Daggers
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to search your deck for a card that has the Knife trait and draw it, then shuffle this card into your deck.

On a character at your location's combat check, bury this card to add a number of d4s equal to the scenario's adventure deck number.
